lesson_fields.starter: Baseline check, not retrieval - this is the first lesson of the unit, so nobody has been taught this yet. A computer in this room is plugged into the school network. Write down three things it can do because of that, which it could not do on its own. Then write one thing that is worse because of it.
lesson_fields.starter_revisits: nothing yet: it is a baseline, and the plan says so
lesson_fields.keyq: What do you gain, and what do you give up, by connecting a computer to a network?

nw-l01-x2.note: 'Name one advantage of a network' against 'understand the advantages of networking'. The match failed because advantage is not advantages and network is not networking, and nothing else in either sentence carries meaning. An earlier note in alignment/nw-l06.json said this lesson states no outcome about advantages; that was wrong, and it is corrected there.
